name: Dig and Hatch a Brainrot [🍓]
desc:
Welcome to Dig and Hatch a Brainrot! 🥚🔥

How to play:
⛏️ Dig for Brainrot eggs!
🏃 Return them to your base safely!
💸 Collect money from hatched Brainrots!
🥶 Buy new shovels and show off your SUPER rare Brainrots!
🌟 Rebirth to unlock cool new machines!

👍 Like the game and join the group!
